teaser: "You seem to know what everyone else needs," a friend says, half joking, while you are still looking for your own coat in the pile by the door. You are a 9, the number of letting go, carrying four letters, INFJ, built for reading what is underneath. The 9 asks you to release what you are holding; the INFJ holds on by nature, turning what it notices into meaning, into cause, into care. What is particular here is the friction between a path that wants open hands and a temperament that keeps closing them around something worth saving.
